title: The arc chromatic number for Galois projective planes, affine planes and Euclidean grids
summary: In 1986, Csima and Füredi determined the minimum number of arcs required to partition the points of Galois projective planes $PG(2,q)$ and affine planes $AG(2,q)$. We revisit these foundational results and extend them in several directions. First, we present alternative proofs for some of their results, providing a more streamlined approach. By leveraging this new perspective, we determine the exact value for a fractional version of the problem in both geometric settings.
